description: PCNN with architectural monotonicity in the LST branch over soft-mode-driver inputs

architecture.lst_head: free MLP(trunk + b_o_reduced_mass) + positive-weight aggregation(soft_mode_activity, lst_enhancement_proxy) + ib_bonus × is_ib, all summed pre-Softplus
guarantees: δ_LST monotone non-decreasing in soft_mode_activity (positive weight × softplus envelope)
δ_LST monotone non-decreasing in lst_enhancement_proxy (positive weight × softplus envelope)
δ_LST monotone non-decreasing in d⁰_B_polarizable_A (positive softplus bonus)

pcnn_reference.note: canonical PCNN has sign-bound but NO monotonicity guarantee
